education.heroLead: A calm, interactive course. Read short lessons, answer knowledge questions and collect XP while building a real understanding of money, scarcity and purchasing power. Your progress is saved automatically in your browser.
education.collectXpText: Every completed lesson and correct answer earns points that build your level.
education.keepStreakText: Learn a little every day and your streak grows — small steps become real knowledge.
education.earnBadgesText: Complete every lesson in a module and unlock a badge for mastering it.

home.heroLead: bitcoinerlife is a calm, data-driven guide to Bitcoin, saving, inflation and purchasing power. No get-rich-quick and no hype — just clear explanations for anyone who wants to understand sounder money.
home.trustTitle: A calm entry into a noisy world
home.trustDescription: Bitcoin is surrounded by noise, speculation and strong opinions. Here I do the opposite: factual, understandable knowledge that helps you think for yourself.
home.trustEducationalText: I explain Bitcoin simply without oversimplifying. You build a real understanding, step by step.
home.trustDataDrivenText: Clear charts and numbers instead of emotions and headlines. See the trend in a longer perspective.
home.trustAntiHypeText: No price predictions, no hot tips. I focus on principles that hold over time.
home.trustLongTermText: I think in years and decades, not weeks. Saving is about patience and sound habits.
home.metricsDescLive: A snapshot of where things stand — price and market cap are fetched live. The full dashboard is on the data page.
home.metricsDescStatic: A snapshot of where things stand. The full dashboard is on the data page.
home.metricsLongDesc: Price at each year-end, in SEK. Illustrates the long run.
home.learnTitle: Learn Bitcoin, step by step, completely free
home.learnLead: An interactive course that takes you from beginner to confident. Short lessons, quizzes and a learning path that makes it easy to keep going, at your own pace.
home.eduPreviewTitle: What do you want to understand today?
home.eduPreviewDescription: Explore the topics. Each track is written to build on the last — start where you are.
home.blogDescription: Guides and explanations that help you understand Bitcoin and your own finances.
home.instagramDescription: Short, understandable Bitcoin thoughts in your feed. Here's a selection — follow for more.
home.instagramSeeMore: See the full account on Instagram
